description: Requests approval to buy one service from find_services. Returns an approval link and match code. Any account member may review and sign the payment in a wallet on superstables.com; nothing is paid until then. Use a new operation_id for each purchase. Within this connection, retrying that ID returns the request while it is kept, without creating another. Revoking and reconnecting starts a new connection.

max_amount.description: The most to pay, in the service's token, such as "0.01"; refused above it

operation_id.description: New for each purchase, the same for a retry of it

params.description: The service's inputs by name, as find_services lists them

recovery.description: Optional. Can only narrow what the account allows for Auto Recovery: rail false means never offer another chain for this request; max_attempts 1 to 3; allowed_networks lists chain ids. It cannot turn anything on.

service_id.description: The id of a service from find_services

name: request_purchase
title: Request purchase approval
